lines.meet: I'm Wes, a warrior, and I'll stand in front. Suit check before you go past the fence, and I mean you.
lines.meet_neighbour: Ariden's Watch, right? I'm on the quarantine fence. Wes, and the mule's not mine, it just follows me.
lines.ask_home: What town did you come up in? I like knowing where people learned their habits.
lines.ask_work: What'd you do for work? I'm guessing something with a procedure, from how you pack.
lines.answer_home: Richland, Washington, a town built for the Hanford plant. My dad was a pipefitter there.
lines.answer_work: Twenty years on the tank farms, cleaning up nuclear waste. In a suit, by the procedure, with a partner, every day.
lines.chat_food: A burger off the grill at a softball game, with the stands half full and the sun going down. Simple food, good evening.
lines.chat_sleep: Lights out at ten, up at five, every day. The procedure doesn't take weekends.
lines.chat_missing: Drives to away games, six hours each way, radio on and a cooler in the back.
lines.chat_here: Standing in front of something bad so nobody else has to, that's the only job I ever wanted. Deadwind suits me fine.
lines.tease_quiet: My old partner talked about as much as you, {name}, and he was the best partner I ever had.
lines.tease_talker: A suit check with you takes twice as long, {name}, because you narrate it.
lines.tease_careful: You'd read the manual twice, {name}. I approve, I read it three times.
lines.tease_bold: You'd skip the suit check if I let you, {name}. I won't let you.
lines.tease_any: The mule likes you, {name}, and the mule doesn't like anybody but me.
lines.tease_back: Huh, good one, {name}. Didn't see it coming.
lines.take_it_kindly: Fair enough, {name}, I'll put that on the list.
lines.bristle: Let's not, {name}. That one's off the list.
lines.apologise: I shouldn't have said that. I'm sorry, and I mean it.
lines.double_down: I checked it twice before I said it, and it still holds.
lines.needle_quiet: You saw a problem and didn't report it. On the tank farms, that's how people get hurt.
lines.needle_talker: Quiet a minute, please. I can't think through the checklist with you going.
lines.needle_careful: You're past careful and into stuck. The checklist's done, go.
lines.needle_bold: You skipped the suit check again. Next time, you don't go past the fence.
lines.needle_any: Everything's going to be fine, according to you. Nothing's ever fine because somebody said so.
lines.bite_back: Twenty years on the tank farms and not one incident. I'll put that against anything you've got.
lines.hurt: Well, that one got through the suit. I'll be at the fence a while.
lines.laugh_off: Twenty years of shift supervisors, and every one of them was meaner than that. It rolls off.
lines.confide: {name}, my wife Diane died when the girls were six and four. I raised them by the procedure, lunches packed the night before and a list on the fridge.
lines.listen: Take it one item at a time, {name}. I'll stay till the list's done.
lines.look_out: Stay one step behind my shield, {name}, and don't go past the fence without me.
lines.accept: All right, {name}, your procedure this time.
lines.deflect: Suit held, {name}, mostly. Check the others.
lines.check_in: Hold still, {name}, I'm doing a check. Where's the damage?
lines.blame: Somebody skipped a step in there. Skipped steps are how people get hurt.
lines.thank: Thanks. I'd have gone down without you, and that's the honest report.
lines.brush_off: You were down, so I got you. That's just the procedure.
lines.worry: That was bad, {name}. Sit still while I check you over.
lines.handed_down: Looks like your gear's on my checklist now. I'll keep it in good order.
lines.hand_fine: It's yours, it fits you right. I don't need more than I've got.
lines.hand_sulk: Would've been nice to be asked first, is all.
lines.turn_friendly: You're my partner on the fence now, {name}, if you want it.
lines.turn_friends: I'd trust you with my suit check, {name}, start to finish.
lines.turn_grating: You and I don't mesh, and I won't pretend otherwise.
lines.turn_rivals: I'll still check your suit. I check everybody, and that includes you.
lines.make_up: Let's put this away, {name}. It's been bothering me.
lines.defend: That's not right, and I've got eyes. Leave {name} alone.
lines.friend_left: The mule keeps looking for {name}, and I've caught myself doing it too.
lines.friend_back: Good to see you, {name}. Suit check, then come on in.
lines.common_radiation: You check for what you can't see, same as me. Folks who've worked hot zones know the danger's always the part you can't see.
lines.common_american: Another American, huh, which state? I'm Washington, the dry side.
lines.common_parent: I raised two girls on my own. Jenna played softball, catcher, and I coached her six seasons.
